repair.content:
S(x,y)=(y,x) conjugates actual and printed maps; arbitrary kicks transform xi_i to Sxi_i; S commutes with heat and preserves square grids/Lp/measure. Apply geometric proof to printed map and transfer; continuous velocity w=S_*u and PDE also conjugate.

Use balls of radius sufficiently larger than the grid scale. Fully contained cells cover >=1/2 forr>=4sqrt2h below injectivity radius, giving tolerance(1+kappa')/2; coarse scales handled by whole-torus zero mean.

Extend discrete correlation bound to Lipschitz observables by periodic mollification and uniform C¹/Lip bounds; pass uniformly in correlation integral. Apply uniform Lip(phi_s) bound for0<=s<=1.
